    10→    fun merge(before: ChangedData<T>?, after: ChangedData<T>): ChangedData<T>? =
    11→        when {

    13→

    15→            // u -> c : 비정상, c를 수행하여 최신화

#### **MergeStrategy** (interface)
**File**: `/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/domain/index/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/domain/index/policy/MergeStrategy.kt`

**Core merge logic**:
```kotlin
fun merge(before: ChangedData<T>?, after: ChangedData<T>): ChangedData<T>? =
    when {
        before == null -> after
        
        // c -> c : duplicate, take after
        // u -> c : abnormal, take c for latest state
        // d -> c : ignore delete, overwrite with create
        after.op == Operation.CREATE -> after
        
        // c -> u : take after data but change op to CREATE
        // u -> u : take latest
        // d -> u : keep delete (prefer "not displayed" over "displayed")
        before.op == Operation.CREATE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> 
            after.apply { op = Operation.CREATE }
        before.op == Operation.UPDATE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> after
        before.op == Operation.DELETE && after.op == Operation.UPDATE -> before
        
        // after is delete → always delete
        after.op == Operation.DELETE -> after
        
        else -> null // log warning
    }
```

**Business Rule**: Prefer deletion over update to avoid showing items that should be hidden.

#### **isUsedOrRentalForCatalog()**

1. Replace boundary chars with space
2. Check against `EXT_CONDI_KEYWORD_P1` (중고, 리퍼, tv가입, 통신가입조건, etc.)
